data.one_liner: Binary MessagePack serializer/deserializer for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to encode Dart objects to MessagePack binary format and decode MessagePack data back to Dart objects. Supports common types, iterables, ByteData, and returns Uint8List.
use_when: You need compact binary serialization for network or storage
Cross‑language data exchange with other MessagePack implementations
avoid_when: You require JSON‑style human readable data
You need schema‑based validation or code‑generated models

alternatives.name: built_value
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides typed, immutable models with code‑gen and can serialize to JSON or binary formats

alternatives.name: json_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard JSON serialization with code‑gen, easier for human‑readable data
